description: Golden cases for the Truth Gate deterministic rules. Shared by the Rust hook (tests/hook.rs) and the Python fallback (hooks/test_truth_gate.py). Each case is the last_assistant_message; expect is block or allow; note, when present, says why. payload_cases are raw Stop-hook stdin payloads (malformed on purpose) that both implementations must parse to the same verdict.
